facts.fact: The ministry's letter of 7 May 2026 says that in the pioneer middle schools teachers record pupils' absence at the start of each lesson and the school administration keys it into the 'Massar+ Idara' application, validates it and classes each absence as justified or not, for daily and real-time monitoring.
The ministry's letter of 7 May 2026 applies daily absence entry in 'Massar+ Idara' to lower secondary schools (the 'pioneer' middle schools, i'dadiyat al-riyada); it does not mention primary schools.

The ministry's letter of 7 May 2026 rolls out a 'new digital component' for daily, real-time monitoring of pupil absence in pioneer middle schools through 'Massar+ Idara', following its letter no. 1931/26 of 6 May 2026 institutionalising that monitoring.

The letter of 7 May 2026 is the Ministry of National Education, Preschool and Sports' own instruction to the regional academies, signed by its secretary-general, setting who records and who validates absence in 'Massar+ Idara'.

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education, Preschool and Sports
systems.tiers: Pioneer middle schools (lower secondary): teachers record absence each lesson, the school administration enters and validates it; technical problems go to provincial and regional services

note: No fact for the schools aspect: the letter concerns pioneer middle schools only, gives no number of them and says nothing of primary schools.
